output.rationale: The requirement specifies the use of standard designs for metal-clad switchgear. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product that provides arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification for metal-clad switchgear at Syracuse Airport. This choice is based on the product's detailed description and relevance to the requirement.
